result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed. The main visual defect is the promotional banner ('3 free deliveries for you'), whose white text has very poor contrast against the pale green background, making the headline and promo code details barely legible.

issues.description: The promo banner text '3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' is white on a light mint-green background, resulting in extremely low contrast and near-illegible text.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker background for the banner or change the text to a dark color (e.g., dark green/charcoal) to meet WCAG contrast ratio requirements (4.5:1 for body text).

issues.description: The 'Order now' button label appears in a light/washed-out green that blends with the button's white background, reducing its visual prominence within the low-contrast banner.
issues.suggestion: Darken the button label color and ensure the button stands out clearly from the banner background.
